decisions.reason: Substantial report on fake LastPass Authenticator GitHub page delivering Alinubx.sys (renamed CcProtect.sys), a Microsoft-signed kernel driver that kills 145 AV/EDR processes before running Rapuncel stealer. DLL side-loading via vsdbg.exe. Driver scored 0 on VirusTotal and was not on Microsoft blocklist. Stealer harvests browser passwords, crypto wallets, Discord/Steam/Telegram sessions. Published Sep 17 by LastPass and Delphos Labs.

decisions.story_title: DPC fines Google EUR 403 million over location data privacy violations
decisions.reason: Irish Data Protection Commission imposed EUR 403 million fine against Google for GDPR violations in processing user location data. Six-year investigation found Google failed to process location data legally, fairly, and transparently in Web and App Activity and Location History. Google must overhaul location data processing within 6 months. Fourth-largest DPC GDPR fine ever.

decisions.story_title: D-Link DIR-822A critical vulnerabilities with public PoC exploit code
decisions.reason: Two critical D-Link DIR-822A vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-86296 CVSS 10.0 stack buffer overflow in udhcpcd DHCP server, CVE-2026-86510 CVSS 9.9 out-of-bounds write in L2TP daemon). Public PoC exploit disclosed. Affected firmware A_101. Unauthenticated LAN attacks possible. No patch available yet. D-Link reviewing scope and remediation.

Additional coverage of CVE-2026-7273 exploitation. This article confirms CISA added the CVE to KEV on Sep 21, 2026. Stack-based buffer overflow in GS1900-48HPv2 CGI program allows unauthenticated remote command execution via crafted HTTP request. Federal agencies must patch by Sep 24. Already has 3 events in story; this adds confirmation of active exploitation.

decisions.story_title: CVE-2026-94493: Critical unauthenticated access in Gigatech PDV5701 with public exploit
decisions.reason: CVSS 10.0 vulnerability in Gigatech PDV5701 1.0.31_240305_112640 WebSocket Service. Missing authentication on /index.html processing allows remote unauthenticated access. Exploit is public. Vendor contacted early but did not respond. No patch available.
